Anna (docs): quick heads-up — opened a small PR to clarify dashboard quick-filters and how they interact with KV-prefix caching. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321
Mike (eng-obsv): linked, thanks. what specifically needs checking? :eyes:
Anna (docs): two things: 1) the sample filter syntax (we switched to a `quick_filters` array rather than inline filters) and 2) a short note about cost/latency attribution when prefix matches are used vs exact keys. want to avoid misleading examples.
Jin (devex): can you drop the sample here? i'll run it in the console playground and sanity-check screenshots.
Anna (docs): sure — snippet below (YAML) showing quick filters + sample metric mapping:
```yaml
dashboard_id: "kv-cache-cost-overview"
quick_filters:
  - label: "Model family"
    field: "model.name"
    type: "select"
    options: ["redwood-7b", "redwood-70b"]
  - label: "KV prefix"
    field: "kv.key_prefix"
    type: "text"
metrics:
  - name: "per_token_cost"
    query: "sum:tokens.cost by kv.key_prefix"
  - name: "avg_latency_ms"
    query: "avg:inference.latency_ms by kv.key_prefix"
```
Olivia (sdk): small heads-up — the Python SDK example in the PR still shows `client.get_dashboard_metrics()` without the new `include_cost_breakdown` flag. we added that param in sdk v0.18.0.
Anna (docs): good catch. i added a TODO in the PR to update python + rust snippets.
Mike (eng-obsv): on the attribution note — suggest wording: "When using kv.key_prefix filters, cost/latency aggregation is by prefix group; exact-key lookups will show per-key attribution. For workloads with long common prefixes, consider adding a sampled per-key trace to avoid over-aggregation."
Anna (docs): love that wording. i put it in the PR under the "Notes on attribution" section.
Sasha (sre): quick question: do we need to mention rollbacks? if quick-filters rely on a new schema field `kv.key_prefix` then older deployments might not export it. add compatibility note.
Anna (docs): yes — added compatibility bullet: "If older SDKs don't emit kv.key_prefix, dashboards will show `unknown` for that filter; upgrade recommendation + migration snippet included."
Jin (devex): ran the playground with the YAML — screenshots attached in PR. filters behave as expected, but one UX quirk: empty text filter currently shows all keys; should we document expected behavior?
Anna (docs): added a short line: "Empty text filter = match all" and example of an empty state screenshot.
Olivia (sdk): i'll make a tiny SDK patch for the Python snippet after lunch. will submit a micro-PR that updates the example and adds `include_cost_breakdown=True` in the call.
deploy-bot: preview build passed — https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood-inference.com/4321 
Mike (eng-obsv): :thumbsup: looks good. one last nit: change metric name from `per_token_cost` to `cost_per_token` to match the metrics registry.
Anna (docs): done. pushed change.
Sasha (sre): approved from infra perspective — compatibility note is clear.
Jin (devex): approved from devex — screenshots + sample validated.
Olivia (sdk): opened sdk PR to update snippets: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/214
Anna (docs): thanks everyone. i'll merge after sdk PR lands and preview updates the snippets. planning to ship the doc update with next docs release. :rocket:
thread_summary: Coordination thread for docs PR clarifying dashboard quick-filters, KV prefix compatibility, and SDK snippet fixes (Python flag and metric naming).
